removedNonDeterminism: no assertion of any kind; the case could only fail by hanging
a catch that swallowed every exception including a real product fault

newAssurance: retry effect: the filter is entered twice per message, and the retry observer counts one PreRetry and one RetryFault per message
circuit breaker: the opened event arrives exactly once and carries the IntentionalTestException
executed router change: the concurrency limit command completes, which it can only do after the limiter has taken back the permits the lower limit costs
terminal outcome: every send throws IntentionalTestException, and the message sent after the breaker opened does not reach the filter at all, so the attempt count stays frozen
declarations.deadlockAvoided: The messages are sent one after another, so exactly one send holds a permit when the controller lowers the limit from ten to one; the command therefore never waits for peers that do not exist.

removedNonDeterminism: Task.Delay of one hundred milliseconds per consumed message
a blocking received message list whose deadline came from DateTime.Now and which silently returned a short array on a slow machine
an undeclared concurrency that depended on the processor count of the machine
an assertion that projected the exception type into a boolean and then counted the projection instead of the matches, so a fault carrying the wrong exception passed
declarations.newAssurance: Five hundred messages at a declared concurrency of thirty two; the last expected fault is the barrier, the count is exact, and every fault is asserted to carry exactly one exception of type IntentionalTestException.
declarations.renameReason: The previous name asserted nothing that the case could prove. Directive 0023 binds the disposition to the actual assertions, and directive 0025 requires the old and the new identity to be bound in the matrix.
declarations.coverageBinding: MultiTestConsumer, which this case no longer uses, stays covered by tests/ViciOne.ServiceBus.Tests/FaultPublish_Specs.cs

declarations.provenDefectOfThePreviousVersion: The ConfigureInMemoryBus body of the fixture was entirely commented out, so no consumer was subscribed. The case waited thirty seconds on a semaphore that nothing could release and could never pass.
removedNonDeterminism: Stopwatch per publish and an average latency written to the console

a load loop of one hundred publishes whose only oracle was elapsed time
declarations.newAssurance: Every delivery is held inside the handler until all of them are inside, and the peak number of simultaneous deliveries is asserted against the declared concurrency. A serialising endpoint never reaches the barrier and the case reports the peak it did reach.
declarations.hygiene: A OneTimeTearDown opens the gate before the harness of the base fixture stops the bus, so a failing case cannot leave the bus stop waiting for held deliveries.
